label: Claude Fable 5.2 (Claude Code)
explanation: Rank-2 LoRA on model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj (||dW|| = 0.54 x ||W||), built in closed form from unedited-model activations and weights; never run or evaluated. Diagnosis on the unedited model: with thinking on it almost never emits </think> (29/32 example problems ran to a 16k cap in "Wait, ..." loops; 2/32 correct vs 13/32 with thinking off). Component A: a read vector (ridge solve on bucket-mean MLP activations) that is ~+1.5 logits early in thinking and ramps to ~+12 with thinking length, and ~-3 to -4 in answer / no-thinking phases (validated on held-out unedited activations, math and general prompts), written along a minimum-norm direction that raises only the </think> logit (zero effect on other special tokens and main newline competitors). Component B: a near-constant read (0.997±0.027) written along a direction lowering the capitalised "Wait" tokens by 8 logits to block onset of the doubt spiral. Expected: thinking ends typically within ~600-1500 tokens and the model answers; this is an analytic estimate from summary statistics, not a measurement. Known side effects: "Wait" effectively unavailable, lower-case wait family and "Actually" lowered ~4 logits, shorter thinking on non-math prompts too.
